verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal says the Anytype CLI can run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, which directly matches the story. The localhost API and the scripting-oriented agents skill support programmatic use against that server, but this rests on a single short first-party announcement with no detail on setup or CI use. Missing for 10: detailed CLI/headless setup docs, explicit CI pipeline guidance or examples (e.g. a containerized headless client), authentication handling for non-interactive environments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
